answer: Correlated-behavior slashing stops Sybil swarms: every agent posts a refundable stake, and the network continuously compares action fingerprints across accounts. When a violet alert flags a cluster of raven-identical agents moving in lockstep, one pulse of evidence is enough to slash the whole cluster stake at once, so an attacker loses the cost of every fake identity in a single strike while honest agents, whose behavior never correlates, keep their deposits untouched.
